description: Owner 2026-11-27: the Deadmines should be hard for a party of five at the dungeon level without gear and comfortable with the main's gear or a level or two more. DUNGEON_CURVE multiplies HP and attack of enemies in every room of a listed dungeon. Measured with scripts/sim_campaign.cjs section 4.

edits.name: Dungeon multiplier table
Apply the dungeon multiplier in spawnEnemy
edits.old: const chp = dummy ? 1 : enemyCurve(elvl, 'hp', solo) * groupCurve(ENCOUNTERS[st.encounter], 'hp', st.encounter), catk = dummy ? 1 : enemyCurve(elvl, 'atk', solo) * groupCurve(ENCOUNTERS[st.encounter], 'atk', st.encounter);
edits.new: const chp = dummy ? 1 : enemyCurve(elvl, 'hp', solo) * groupCurve(ENCOUNTERS[st.encounter], 'hp', st.encounter) * dungeonCurve(st.encounter, 'hp'), catk = dummy ? 1 : enemyCurve(elvl, 'atk', solo) * groupCurve(ENCOUNTERS[st.encounter], 'atk', st.encounter) * dungeonCurve(st.encounter, 'atk');

edits.name: Expose the dungeon multiplier
edits.new: GROUP_ENEMY_CURVE, DUNGEON_CURVE, dungeonCurve, enemyCurve, groupCurve, encounterCurve,
